title: PCNM
description: Classical MDS axes of a distance matrix truncated at the PCNM threshold.

sample_dim.title: Sample dimension
sample_dim.description: Name of the first distance axis.

sample_b_dim.title: Second sample dimension
sample_b_dim.description: Name of the second distance axis.

threshold.title: Distance threshold
threshold.description: Longer distances are replaced by four times this value. Defaults to the largest minimum-spanning-tree edge.

n_axes.title: Number of axes
n_axes.description: Maximum number of positive axes to keep; 0 keeps every positive axis.
